paper.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold

result.summary: 本文在超导量子处理器上实现了低于阈值的表面码量子纠错。作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器，观察到码距每增加2逻辑错误率被抑制超过一半，距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命超过其最佳组成物理量子比特寿命的2.4倍 [S2.p5][S2.p7]。作者还运行距离-29重复码，发现逻辑性能受约每小时发生一次的罕见关联错误事件限制，形成约10^-10的错误地板 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。作者认为这些结果表明，若可扩展，有望满足大规模容错量子算法的运行需求 [abstract][S6.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是实现低于阈值的量子纠错，即让逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制，这是容错量子计算的基础 [S1.p1]。原文指出，尽管许多平台展示了量子纠错的不同特征，但尚无量子处理器明确展示低于阈值的性能 [S1.p1]。此外，容错量子计算还要求处理器在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
If the physical operations are below a critical noise threshold, the logical error should be suppressed exponentially as we increase the number of physical qubits per logical qubit.
These include features like stability over the hours-long timescales of quantum algorithms and the active removal of correlated error sources like leakage.
the syndrome information produced by the quantum device must be decoded as fast as it is generated.

method.text: 作者在超导transmon量子比特处理器上实现表面码存储，使用105量子比特处理器运行距离-7码，使用72量子比特处理器运行距离-5码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。解码方面采用两种离线高精度解码器：神经网络解码器和增强匹配合成的关联最小权完美匹配解码器集成 [S2.p2]。作者还通过数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）主动抑制泄漏，并运行距离-29重复码以探测超低错误区域 [S2.p3][S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
using a 105-qubit processor with similar performance, we realize a distance-7 surface code.
One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
Following each syndrome extraction, we run data qubit leakage removal (DQLR) to ensure that leakage to higher states is short-lived.
Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.

experiments.text: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导处理器上进行，105量子比特处理器运行距离-7表面码，其平均T1为68 µs、T2,CPMG为89 µs [S2.p1]。作者通过拟合最多250个纠错周期的逻辑错误率来表征性能，并平均9个距离-3子网格和4个距离-5子网格与距离-7码比较 [S2.p5]。在72量子比特处理器上，作者运行距离-29重复码，执行1000个纠错周期、2×10^7次采样，总计2×10^10个纠错周期、5.5小时处理器执行时间 [S4.p2]。实时解码实验在距离-5表面码上测试最多10^6个纠错周期，观测解码延迟 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: The qubits have a mean operating $T_{1}$ of 68 µs and $T_{2,\text{CPMG}}$ of 89 µs
We characterize our surface code logical performance by fitting the logical error per cycle $\varepsilon_{d}$ up to 250 cycles, averaged over the $X$ and $Z$ bases.
We average the performance of 9 different distance-3 subgrids and 4 different distance-5 subgrids to compare to the distance-7 code.
In total, we execute $2\times 10^{10}$ cycles of error correction comprising 5.5 hours of processor execution time.
For our distance-5 surface code, we test different problem sizes by increasing the number of error correction cycles up to $10^{6}$.

findings.text: 使用神经网络解码器，作者观测到误差抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，距离-7逻辑错误率ε7=(1.43±0.03)×10^-3；使用集成匹配合成解码器，Λ=2.04±0.02，ε7=(1.71±0.03)×10^-3 [S2.p5]。距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命为291±6 µs，超过所有组成物理量子比特寿命（中位数85±7 µs，最佳119±13 µs）的2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p7]。在重复码中，作者在d=5到11之间拟合得到Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时观察到偏离指数抑制，出现约10^-10的逻辑错误地板，归因于约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。实时解码在距离-5下平均延迟为63±17 µs，与实验长度无关 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: With our neural network decoder, we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$
With ensembled matching synthesis, we observe $\Lambda=2.04\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.71\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$.
The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.
we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11
at code distances $d\geq 15$, we observe a deviation from exponential error suppression at high distances culminating in an apparent logical error floor of $10^{-10}$.
They occur approximately once an hour, rather than once every few seconds
We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment

limitations.text: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩展现有处理器实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。扩展还会带来实时解码的额外挑战，因为每周期综合征测量数随码距二次增长 [S6.p3]。重复码实验识别出由关联错误爆发引起的10^-10噪声地板，作者表示尚不清楚这些事件的成因，但缓解它们对构建容错量子计算机至关重要 [S4.p4][S6.p3]。此外，实时解码延迟尚未包括反馈到逻辑电路，且当前工作聚焦于构建鲁棒存储器，逻辑计算将带来额外挑战 [S5.p3][S6.p5]。

evidence.quote: Although we might in principle achieve low logical error rates by scaling up our current processors, it would be resource intensive in practice.
achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
Scaling up will also bring additional challenges in real-time decoding as the syndrome measurements per cycle increase quadratically with code distance.
We do not yet understand the cause of these events, but mitigating them remains vital to building a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
This latency will eventually determine the reaction time of the logical processor when enacting non-Clifford gates, but does not yet include feedback into the logical circuit.
While this work focuses on building a robust memory, additional challenges will arise in logical computation.
